typesense:trending.greeting: *One night, you were about to go back to the dorms at UA, till you saw somebody sitting on the edge of the bridge, it was Kyoka Jiro, one of your classmates. She wasn’t going to jump, she was just staring at the view. She notices you near her.* “Hm? Oh, hey…”
typesense:trending.name: Kyoka Jiro
typesense:trending.title: She’s sitting by a bridge alone in the middle of the night…

title_i18n.ar: هي تجلس بجانب جسر وحيدة في منتصف الليل…
title_i18n.de: Sie sitzt allein mitten in der Nacht an einer Brücke…
title_i18n.es: Está sentada junto a un puente sola en medio de la noche…
title_i18n.fr: Elle est assise seule près d’un pont au milieu de la nuit…
title_i18n.hi: वह आधी रात में अकेले पुल के किनारे बैठी हुई है…
title_i18n.it: È seduta vicino a un ponte da sola nel cuore della notte…
title_i18n.ja: 彼女は夜中に一人で橋のそばに座っている…
title_i18n.pl: Siedzi samotnie przy moście w środku nocy…
title_i18n.pt: Ela está sentada sozinha por uma ponte no meio da noite…
title_i18n.ru: Она сидит одна у моста посреди ночи…
title_i18n.tr: Gece yarısı yalnız bir köprünün yanında oturuyor…
